Casa Fontana Resort sits on the stretch of Beach Road that quietly links Colva's busier promenade to Betalbatim's calmer sand, giving guests the choice of either mood within a short walk. The property itself leans into old Goan-Portuguese style — arched corridors, terracotta tones, and a courtyard built around an oval-shaped pool that's become something of a signature for the resort.

Rooms are genuinely spacious by South Goa standards, finished with clean, modern washrooms that don't try to overplay the heritage theme at the expense of everyday comfort. Heritage Suites add a sitting area worth the upgrade for families wanting a bit more room to spread out.

Betalbatim's beach, one of the calmer stretches in the Colva belt, is a short walk from the property, while Colva's wider selection of restaurants and shacks is an easy ride away for evenings when guests want more choice. The resort's own restaurant covers both Goan classics and a broader menu for guests who'd rather not venture out every night.

We recommend Casa Fontana most to families and couples who want the charm of an old-Goa-style property without giving up modern comfort, positioned to enjoy both Colva's energy and Betalbatim's quiet. As an independent broker with over eight years of experience across Goa, Goa Beach Stays personally vets every property we list — WhatsApp us for current rates and availability.

faqs.question: How far is Casa Fontana Resort from the beach?
faqs.answer: The resort is a short 400-metre walk from Betalbatim Beach and close to Colva Beach as well.

faqs.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Check-in is at 12:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out can be arranged on request, subject to availability.

faqs.question: How do I book Casa Fontana Resort?
faqs.answer: Bookings are enquiry-based. Send us a WhatsApp message or call us with your dates and number of guests, and we will confirm availability and the best rate for your stay.

faqs.question: Are peak-season rates different?
faqs.answer: Yes. During Goa's peak season (November, December and January) rates are typically higher than the standard rate. Both rates are shown transparently on this page.

faqs.question: What makes the pool at Casa Fontana distinctive?
faqs.answer: The resort's pool is oval-shaped and set within a Portuguese-style courtyard, a deliberate architectural feature rather than a standard rectangular pool.

reviews.name: Priyank Solanki
reviews.review: Loved being able to walk to Betalbatim for a quiet morning and Colva in the evening for more choice of restaurants. The oval pool is genuinely pretty too.

reviews.name: Hannah & Peter Wilkes
reviews.review: The Portuguese architecture won us over immediately, and the rooms were far more spacious than we expected for the price.
